jess (design): quick spot from the console QA pass — when you open a model row the focus lands on the header, but VoiceOver says "breadcrumb, Back to models, Open" which is noisy. can we make the initial focus more concise? omar (a11y): I noticed this too. reproducer: VoiceOver on mac, tab to list, press Enter on a row. The crumb is an actual
so VO reads the whole thing. we should hide the breadcrumb from assistive tech until after the first meaningful focus. li (frontend): agreed. quick thought: add aria-hidden="true" on the breadcrumb until after onOpen() completes, then remove it. simple and low-risk. ben (pm): sounds reasonable. any concerns about focus loss when we toggle aria-hidden? also we need a copy tweak for the breadcrumb link — currently reads "Back to models list" but we use "Models" elsewhere. consistency wins. omar (a11y): toggling aria-hidden can cause VO to jump. alternative: keep breadcrumb in DOM but set role="presentation" and remove inner link from tab order (tabindex="-1") until after open. that'll keep tree stable. li (frontend): nice — role=presentation + tabindex=-1 is easier. code snippet I tried locally: ```html
Models
// after open: bcLink.removeAttribute('tabindex'); bcNav.removeAttribute('role'); ``` omar (a11y): that should work. also, change link text to just "Models" (screen reader will get context from page title). less verbosity. jess (design): love the minimal copy. can we also check contrast for the focus ring on the row? I noticed the custom focus outline is subtle on dark mode. li (frontend): noted — the focus ring uses rgba(100,150,255,0.3) on dark, which is under WCAG 2.1 for 3:1 for 2px. I'll bump to 0.6 and test. omar (a11y): while you're in there, ensure the row's inner interactive elements have visible focus (not just outline on container). keyboard users must see which control is focused. ben (pm): schedule-wise, can this be a patch for the next minor? it's low-risk but impacts onboarding flow. li (frontend): yep, I can land a patch. plan: (1) role=presentation + tabindex=-1 toggle for breadcrumb, (2) change copy to "Models", (3) increase focus ring opacity and explicitly style focus for inner buttons. will send PR shortly. jess (design): thanks. @omar could you please quick smoke-test VoiceOver after the PR? a thumbs-up from you is enough. :thumbsup: omar (a11y): will do. quick checklist I'll run: initial focus announcement, no duplicate live region reads, breadcrumb not announced on open, inner button focus visible. aria-bot: Accessibility checklist reminder — run Axe, WAVE, and a keyboard-only traversal. Report in the PR. li (frontend): will attach Axe run and a short screen recording. aiming to merge tomorrow morning. ben (pm): great — thanks team. small follow-up: add a one-line note to the release changelog about the focus/voiceover improvement for folks on assistive tech. jess (design): and copy tweak confirmed: "Models". small but clearer. thanks! :sparkles:
